name: Drinks & Liquids
description: Shaken, not... spilled? Adds puddles to several thrown items. Water and wine (electricity), alcohol (flammable) and soda (slippery).

options.name: Water
options.tooltip: Water pools from Atlantide bottle, martini shaker, and snow globe

options.name: Alcohol
options.tooltip: Makes vodka and whiskey bottles spill flammable alcohol

options.name: Alcohol (Quest items)
options.tooltip: Makes quest item vodka bottles throwable and create flammable puddles. Slightly bugged still - the bottles will become invisible when placed with their quest prompts, but still function for the quest poisonings.

options.name: Wine
options.tooltip: Throwing wine bottles creates pools of wine that can electrocute like water

options.name: Soda
options.tooltip: Throwing soda cans creates slippery puddles of soda

options.name: NPC Drinks
options.tooltip: When NPCs drop their drinks, they will create slippery puddles. Made more NPCs drop drinks instead of teleporting them back to starting positions. Let me know if you find any NPCs doing magic drink teleporting and I'll try to patch them.

options.name: BONUS | Overpowered Water Canister
options.tooltip: So it's not a usless item with all the liquid throwables, this makes the water canister MUCH stronger. Experiment and find out :) (try shooting it)

options.name: Safehouse | Atlantide
options.tooltip: Adds the Atlantide water bottle to the kitchen

options.name: Safehouse | Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds a vodka bottle to the garage

options.name: Safehouse | New York Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the New York vodka bottle to the savehouse in an unspecified location. It'll be easy to find :) ONLY USE IF YOU HAVE QUEST VODKA TURNED ON!

options.name: Safehouse | Jasper Knight Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the vodka bottle from the tutorial mission to the kitchen. ONLY USE IF YOU HAVE QUEST VODKA TURNED ON!

options.name: Safehouse | Martini Shaker
options.tooltip: Adds the martini shaker to the kitchen

options.name: Safehouse | Whiskey
options.tooltip: Adds the whiskey bottle to the safehouse. Location unspecified. Label reads 'Lady of the Lake'

options.name: Unlock | Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the regular vodka bottle as to mission planning loadout

options.name: Unlock | Atlantide
options.tooltip: Adds the Atlantide water bottle to the mission planning loadout

options.name: Unlock | Soda
options.tooltip: Adds the 3x Soda Can to mission planning screen.

options.name: Unlock | New York Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the New York vodka bottle as unlockable. ONLY USE IF YOU HAVE QUEST VODKA TURNED ON!

options.name: Unlock | Jasper Knight Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the vodka bottle from the tutorial mission as unlockable. ONLY USE IF YOU HAVE QUEST VODKA TURNED ON!

options.name: Unlock | Whiskey
options.tooltip: Adds the whiskey bottle to the mission planning screen as unlockable

options.name: Unlock | Water Canister
options.tooltip: Adds the water canister to the mission planning loadout.

options.name: (WIP) Overpowered Oil Canister
options.tooltip: Work in progress, makes the oil canister far more powerful by [REDACTED]

options.name: (WIP) Champagne Glass
options.tooltip: Adds throwable champagne glass which also works as a melee weapon. Creates slippery puddle when thrown or dropped. Work in progress, may be buggy.

options.name: (WIP) Whiskey Glass
options.tooltip: Adds throwable whiskey glass which creates a slippery puddle. Throwable only right now, eventually will add melee

german.ui_prop_melee_whiskey_glass_desc: Ein stabiles Whiskyglas. Zerbrich es, um eine rutschige Pfütze zu erzeugen.

spanish.ui_prop_melee_whiskey_glass_desc: Un resistente vaso de whisky. Rómpelo para crear un charco resbaladizo.

russian.ui_prop_melee_whiskey_glass_desc: Прочный стакан для виски. Разбейте его, чтобы создать скользкую лужу.
